insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Varus is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Varus in 24/38 games (63%): 2 picks (0-2) and 22 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No K'Sante? They go Gnar
insights.text: K'Sante is a G1 favorite (7/22 G1s, played by Empyros). In the 9 later games where it was burned or banned, Empyros went to Gnar (3/9) and Sion (2/9).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Vi against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Vi against them in 21/38 games (55%).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: They fade once their pool is burned

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 5 G3+ games, 10/25 picks (40%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 43 champs in G1s, 19 in G3+.
